name: Audience modal
summary: The audience phone's modal, the mobile twin of the DS Modal: one centred card for option details, an action or a confirmation, with no dark backdrop so nothing is cut off inside an iframe.
highlights: Pinned actions, stacked full width on a phone
No backdrop, iframe safe, close event with a returnValue
lead: ONE custom element, <aha-audience-modal>, for every modal on the audience phone of a slide type (a cross-origin iframe on the Developer Platform). It follows the DS Modal's two types, Action and Confirmation, and adds Details for showing one option in full. A backdrop is cut off at the iframe edge, so the card carries a 1px border and a soft shadow instead, and an invisible layer catches a tap outside it. Framework-free, loaded by URL from the version-pinned CDN with tokens.css.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS, so the render is identical. React (< 19) binds events through a ref; Vue binds the custom element natively. <aha-bottom-sheet> is a deprecated alias of the same element.

spec.label: Card
spec.value: white, 1px border, radius 8, shadow 0 8 24 ink at 30%, up to 480 wide, never taller than its container minus a 16px gutter; no backdrop

spec.label: Header
spec.value: heading 18 SemiBold, line height 1.3, 24 from the left edge; the close ✕ is the audience Close button (36 x 36 drawn, 44 x 44 hit area) 8 from the top right corner

spec.label: Body
spec.value: 16 / 24 text, 24 side padding, scrolls inside the card when it is tall; details keep the option's line breaks and show the picture above the text

spec.label: Actions
spec.value: slot="actions", 8 apart, 24 side and bottom padding, pinned below the body; stacked full width with the first on top below a 400px card, one row with the first rightmost from 400px

spec.label: Types
spec.value: details (✕, no heading) · action (heading + ✕) · confirmation (heading as a question + one line, no ✕, alertdialog)

spec.label: Dismiss
spec.value: ✕, Escape and a tap outside close it with `dismiss`; `destructive` ignores the tap outside

spec.label: Motion
spec.value: fades and scales in from 96% over motion-mid with ease-out; just appears under reduced motion

props.name: open
props.desc: Shows the modal. Removing it closes the modal with `dismiss`

props.name: type
props.desc: details shows one option in full; action is a task surface; confirmation is a yes/no decision, announced as an alertdialog, with no ✕

props.name: heading
props.desc: The title; names the dialog. A confirmation's heading is a question ("Leave the quiz?")

props.name: destructive
props.desc: A destructive confirmation: a tap outside does nothing, so a stray tap cannot decide; Escape and the buttons still work

props.name: (slot)
props.desc: The body: the full option text, a form, or the confirmation's one line

props.name: actions (slot)
props.desc: The buttons, primary first: `variant="primary" size="touch"`, `secondary-deck` or `danger`. A tap on one with `data-action` emits `action` and closes with that value

props.name: image
props.desc: details: the picture above the text

props.name: label
props.desc: Translated dialog name when there is no heading

props.name: contained
props.desc: Centred inside the nearest positioned ancestor (a phone frame in docs) instead of the viewport

props.name: inline
props.desc: Drawn in the page flow, for docs

props.name: show()
props.desc: Opens it; resolves with the returnValue it closes with

props.name: close(value)
props.desc: Closes it with that returnValue; call it after an async action you held open with preventDefault()

props.name: returnValue
props.desc: The `data-action` value it closed with, or `dismiss`

props.name: action
props.desc: Cancelable: a `data-action` button was tapped. preventDefault() keeps the modal open (busy state, inline error), then call close(action)

props.name: close
props.desc: Fires after every close, whichever way it closed; detail.returnValue says which

whenToUse.when: an option is too long for its row or its picture should be seen larger: open it from the `expand` event of <aha-answer-option expandable> or <aha-rank-list expandable>
a short task the participant starts on purpose: change a display name, pick one of a few actions
an answer or exit that cannot be undone needs a yes or no first
app screens, never the audience phone: it is antd with a full-screen mask

opinion.note: Name every button for its action ("Send answer", "Leave quiz", never OK). One primary per modal. A destructive confirmation sets `destructive`, makes the safe choice the primary and puts the destructive action on `variant="danger"` (status carries no hue, so danger draws like secondary). For an async action call preventDefault() on `action`, set `loading` on the button, await, then close(action), or keep the modal open and show the error inline. Never open a modal from a pick, and never stack a second one for an error. Call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once so the primary button takes the deck accent.

snippets.note: The native form — a version-pinned CDN import and plain HTML, for a build-less slide page.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP), on the inline examples with no deck applied (DS defaults).
conformance.measure: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('aha-audience-modal[data-probe]');var r=el.shadowRoot;function cs(n){return n?getComputedStyle(n):{}}var p=cs(r.querySelector('.panel'));var t=cs(r.querySelector('.title'));var a=cs(r.querySelector('.actions'));var c=document.querySelector('aha-audience-modal[type=confirmation]').shadowRoot;return{surface:p.backgroundColor,edge:p.borderTopColor,ink:t.color,radius:p.borderTopLeftRadius,border:p.borderTopWidth,titleSize:t.fontSize,titleWeight:t.fontWeight,actionsDirection:a.flexDirection,actionsGap:a.rowGap,confirmationClose:cs(c.querySelector('.close')).display,confirmationRole:c.querySelector('.panel').getAttribute('role')};})()
